published_ranges._ams: Polymaker: caution with AMS and multi-material systems (brittle and abrasive); keep bend diameter above 60 mm.
published_ranges._notes: TDS: brass nozzle life about 9 h, hardened steel or ruby nozzle highly recommended; keep below 20% RH; filament is brittle (bend diameter >60 mm). Wiki requirements: all-metal hotend 260C+. Other thermal rows in the TDS text layer are garbled, only Vicat kept.
